description: Make a map of the terrain studio the world of a game that has the world.terrain kit. Pass map (a terrain studio map id, lvl_…) or scene (a scene id, with terrain when the scene has several terrain nodes). The map is baked once into a file (heights, ground roles, lakes and rivers, vegetation, roads, spawn and objective points) stored in the Library and bound to the terrain_map slot; the project data keeps its reference in terrain_maps. The same file is delivered to Godot, Unity and Unreal with the kit. Buildings and other non-vegetation props, and terrain holes, are not carried yet (counted in map.notCarried). Without a bound map world.terrain keeps generating its world from the seed. 0 credits.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

scene.description: Scene id whose terrain node becomes the world (instead of map).

terrain.description: Terrain node id in the scene (default: its first terrain).

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_terrain_map_use
title: Play a terrain studio map in a game
